ride.curvature: measured separately, not a pass threshold

protocol.opportunity: General every-base protection plus style available from at least half of bases; alternate good styles allowed.
protocol.resistance: General every-base protection plus no retained supported efficient non-style route from any base.
protocol.selection: Generate legal route endpoints, qualify proposal style, then prioritize minimum pure-paint world separation before featured magnitude. Audit every base before acceptance. No failed style is relabeled as a success.
protocol.validation: Same fixed rules and palette set on both seeds. Second seed is fresh numerical replication, not player validation. Dense-check leading passing opportunities and strongest protected near-misses.
protocol.labels: Intended style stays visible in any subsequent lab.
protocol.scope: Offline feasibility only; no live holes, par, tolerance, palette definitions, or animations changed.

limitations: Fresh-seed replication is not player validation. No reviewed target recipes used.
Proposal separation is a lower-bound heuristic, not a guarantee of a long ride; full all-base audits decide acceptance.
One/two additions are sampled across all orders with refinement; three-addition witnesses follow generating-recipe permutations.
Resistance means no retained supported efficient bypass found, not an exhaustive proof.
Curvature is reported separately and is not a pass threshold. Up/down are reported separately and together.
No live lab, palette definitions, par or tolerance changed. Intended labels remain visible in a subsequent lab.
